info.name: RideLink - Auto Test Suite v2
info.description:
Self-contained, re-runnable test suite for the 4 RideLink microservices (account 8081, driver 8082, ride 8083, payment 8084).

How to run: import this collection + the RideLink Local environment, start the 4 services, then use the Collection Runner (Run collection) or newman. Every request has test assertions and passes data to the next request through collection variables. Unique emails are generated on each run, so it can be run again and again.

Run the folders in order (the Runner does this by default). Sample data is fictional.
